# NEW 2026-11-23 v21.0 Module E2: Scripted Effects: O(1) Yearly Hook (oe_dis2_kernel_yearly) & P21 Live Probe (oe_dis2_probe_p21) (oe_dis2_, 0 mainline slots, 0 rules, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v210_disasters_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Global scope. Strip all Competitive AI Great-Power Resilience modifiers immediately.
oe_dis2_clear_all_ai_resilience = {
	every_country = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2 }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2
		}
	}
}

# Global scope. Main exported O(1) yearly hook for oe_gk_yearly_dispatch.
# Self-deduplicated via global_var:oe_dis2_ran_y ?= current_year.
# Strictly non-cheating: applies only modest fiscal/diplomatic/resilience modifiers
# (discipline <= 0.03, land_morale_modifier <= 0.05) to surviving AI Great Powers
# when a human player crosses late-game snowball thresholds, with full player opt-out.
oe_dis2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_dis2_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ran_y value = current_year }

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dis2_init } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis2_init value = 1 }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_dis2_tick_count value = 0 }
		}
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_dis2_tick_count add = 1 }

		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dis2_ai_rivalry_disabled }
			oe_dis2_clear_all_ai_resilience = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_dis2_world_has_player_t2 = yes }
			every_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { oe_dis2_ai_gp_candidate = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1 }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2
						years = 2
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1 }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2 }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2
					}
				}
			}
			oe_dis2_notify_snowball_players_t2 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_dis2_world_has_player_t1 = yes }
			every_country = {
				if = {
					limit = { oe_dis2_ai_gp_candidate = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2 }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1
						years = 2
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1 }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2 }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2
					}
				}
			}
			oe_dis2_notify_snowball_players_t1 = yes
		}
		else = {
			oe_dis2_clear_all_ai_resilience = yes
		}
	}
}

# Global scope. Fire Counter-Hegemony Concert warning events to snowballing human players (Tier 1).
oe_dis2_notify_snowball_players_t1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t1
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes oe_dis2_player_snowball_t1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_19_fired } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_19_fired value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd value = 1 years = 20 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.19
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_19_fired
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd value = 1 years = 25 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.21
			}
		}
	}
}

# Global scope. Fire Grand Counter-Hegemony escalation events to snowballing human players (Tier 2).
oe_dis2_notify_snowball_players_t2 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_ai_gp_resilience_t2
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes oe_dis2_player_snowball_t2 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_19_fired } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_19_fired value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd value = 1 years = 20 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.19
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_20_fired } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_20_fired value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd value = 1 years = 20 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.20
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_ev_21_cd value = 1 years = 25 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dis2.21
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Increment step counter for whichever of the 6 disasters is active.
oe_dis2_bump_overext_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_dis2_overext_steps }
		change_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_steps add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_dis2_overext_steps value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Non-destructive P21 Live Engine Probe Hook for Module E2.
# Records integer pass bitmask in var:oe_probe2_p21:
#   +1     oe_dis2_kernel_yearly executed and set global_var:oe_dis2_ran_y
#   +10    global_var:oe_dis2_init initialized & global_var:oe_dis2_tick_count >= 1
#   +100   static modifier round-trip verified (apply & immediately restore if not held)
#   +1000  Age 5-6 disaster era-lock guard verified (oe_dis2_age5_lock_ok = yes)
# Full pass = 1111.
oe_dis2_probe_p21 = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_probe2_p21 value = 0 }
	oe_dis2_kernel_yearly = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dis2_ran_y }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe2_p21 add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = oe_dis2_init
			has_global_variable = oe_dis2_tick_count
			global_var:oe_dis2_tick_count >= 1
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe2_p21 add = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_exchequer_reform }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe2_p21 add = 100 }
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dis2_mod_exchequer_reform years = 1 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_exchequer_reform }
			remove_country_modifier = oe_dis2_mod_exchequer_reform
			change_variable = { name = oe_probe2_p21 add = 100 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { oe_dis2_age5_lock_ok = yes }
		change_variable = { name = oe_probe2_p21 add = 1000 }
	}
}
